sentences.text: Waves grow with three things: wind speed; fetch, the distance of open water the wind blows across; and duration, how long it has blown.
That’s why an offshore wind leaves a calm strip near the beach, while the same wind blowing onshore across a long fetch builds big seas.
Swell is waves that have traveled away from where they formed, and it can arrive well ahead of a distant storm.
Forecast wave heights are significant wave heights, the average of the highest one third of the waves, so expect some individual waves much larger, occasionally around twice the forecast height.
